en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from ’Asim al-Khayyat from Abi Hamzah al-Thumali from Ali b. al-Hussain (a.s.) who said: “

One who recites Surah Mumtahena in his obligatory and recommended prayer, Allah examines his heart for belief, and brightens his sight and he is never ever afflicted with poverty, insanity in himself or his children.”
